Yesterday's HIGH priority item #1 SKIP - port already complete.

- **Why**: Yesterday's research (2026-10-15 #1) proposed auditing grep.ts for bytes-field handling to prevent Latin-1 file match drops. Audit complete 2026-10-16: Alexi already implements upstream kilocode fix. SKIP - no gap exists.

#### 3. Cline stream retry + Langfuse error reporting MEDIUM ~6-8h (providers, telemetry, error handling)

- **What**: Cline PR #15100 (merged 2026-10-16) enables three stream retries with terminal error reporting to Langfuse. Commit title: "fix(llms): retry stream errors and report terminal failures to Langfuse". Issue: stream failures (network blips mid-response, aborted connections) were not retried (attempt-level code only retried request-level failures), and terminal errors (bad API key, quota exceeded) were not reported to Langfuse as error spans (success span closed even when request failed). Fix: (1) enable three stream retries (attempt-level retry wraps stream parsing, same exponential backoff as request retries), (2) classify attempt errors before exporting spans (terminal errors: auth, quota, validation; transient errors: network, timeout, 502/503), (3) close failed attempt spans with error status in Langfuse (preserve successful span completion timing, failed spans get error context fields: errorType, errorMessage, isTerminal), (4) correlate model failures and distinguish timeout aborts (timeout abort is transient, connection error mid-stream is also transient unless it's a 4xx-class error), (5) document request vs stream retry ownership (request retries owned by SDK client, stream retries owned by Cline's attempt wrapper).

- **Why**: Alexi has stream-based LLM calls (src/core/streamingOrchestrator.ts, src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts) and Langfuse telemetry (src/providers/langfuse-telemetry.ts). Check if Alexi retries stream failures (network blips mid-response) and reports terminal stream errors as error spans in Langfuse. Cline pattern: (1) three-retry stream error handling (transient failures retried with exponential backoff, terminal failures surface immediately), (2) Langfuse error span correlation (failed attempts close Langfuse spans with error status + context fields: errorType, errorMessage, isTerminal). Alexi equivalent: audit (1) ErrorBackoff (src/core/error-backoff.ts) vs stream failures - does retry loop cover stream parsing errors or only request-level failures? (2) Langfuse span lifecycle (src/providers/langfuse-telemetry.ts finishLangfuseGeneration / failLangfuseGeneration) - are stream failures captured as error spans or do they leave spans open/success when request fails mid-stream? (3) Error classification (transient vs terminal) aligns with ARCHITECTURE.md contract - does stream error handler respect permanent vs transient buckets? MEDIUM ~6-8h: verify stream failures close Langfuse spans with error status, add attempt-level span correlation if missing, test network-blip-mid-stream retry + Langfuse error capture.

- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15100 (stream retry + Langfuse error spans), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/error-backoff.ts (ErrorBackoff retry logic), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/providers/langfuse-telemetry.ts (Langfuse span lifecycle), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (error classification contract)

- **Category**: providers (stream retry, langfuse telemetry, error spans)

- **Size**: MEDIUM ~6-8h (audit if stream failures retry + close Langfuse error spans, add attempt-level error span correlation if missing, test network-blip retry + Langfuse capture)

#### 4. Cline Dependabot floor lifts SMALL ~2-3h (deps, security, advisories)

- **What**: Cline PR #15132 (merged 2026-10-16) addressed open Dependabot security advisories via dependency floor lifts. Commit title: "security: dependency floor lifts for open Dependabot advisories". Change: bump minimum versions of dependencies with known security issues to versions where Dependabot no longer flags advisories. Typical pattern: `"foo": "^1.2.3"` becomes `"foo": "^1.2.5"` where 1.2.5 is the first version with the security patch. Does not upgrade to latest/major - only lifts floor to clear advisory. Mirrors Alexi's dependency bump strategy (fix security advisories without breaking changes).

- **Why**: Alexi has Dependabot enabled (.github/dependabot.yml) and may have open security advisories. Cline pattern: periodic sweep of Dependabot alerts, lift dependency floors to patched versions. Alexi equivalent: (1) check open Dependabot security advisories (`gh api repos/YOUR_ORG/alexi/dependabot/alerts --jq '.[] | select(.state == "open")'`), (2) if advisories exist, bump affected dependency floors to versions where advisory is fixed (check package.json + package-lock.json), (3) test (npm run test:coverage), (4) commit with `fix(deps): lift dependency floors for Dependabot advisories` message. SMALL ~2-3h: audit open advisories, lift floors if advisories exist, test.

- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/15132 (Dependabot floor lifts), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/.github/dependabot.yml (Alexi Dependabot config), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/package.json (dependency manifest)

- **Category**: deps (security, dependabot, advisories)

- **Size**: SMALL ~2-3h (check open Dependabot advisories via gh api, lift dependency floors to patched versions if advisories exist, test)
